steps.npc: They say it's some kind of powerful fire spirit.
What it is doesn't bother me, just as long as we keep it behind the Doors.

options.text: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.

steps.player: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.

steps.npc: The Doors were built by Dinh to contain the Wintertodt. This was over a thousand years ago and they still stand today.
Dinh was the greatest smith that the world has ever seen. I am the finest smith around today and even I cannot match his abilities.
The name's Undor. You'll struggle to find a dwarf in this land who knows more about metalwork than me.
One day I hope to be as good as the legendary Dinh himself.

steps.text: If the player has not completed The Forsaken Tower:

steps.npc: They say the doors are failing and the Wintertodt is trying to escape. I'm here to prove to them that the Doors are fine.
Of course they are! They were made by Dinh himself.

steps.text: If the player completed The Forsaken Tower:

steps.npc: I'm just here to keep an eye on things. Even though the Doors are fixed now, it will take many years for things to get back to normal.
